text:
The quiet craft of Japanese carpentry

Temple carpenters in Japan join timber without nails. Interlocking joints such as the kanawa tsugi let beams flex in earthquakes, and hinoki cypress grows stronger for centuries after it is cut.
title: The quiet craft of Japanese carpentry

text:
Cohort retention curves for SaaS

A chart of monthly cohort retention shows where users churn. Flattening curves after month three signal product-market fit; a blue line marks the median cohort.
title: Cohort retention curves for SaaS

text:
HNSW graphs explained

Hierarchical navigable small world graphs give approximate nearest neighbour search with logarithmic hops. The ef_search parameter trades recall against latency.
title: HNSW graphs explained

text:
Product quantization for vector compression

Product quantization splits vectors into subspaces and encodes each with a small codebook, cutting memory by an order of magnitude at some cost in recall.
title: Product quantization for vector compression

text:
A beginner's sourdough schedule

Feed the starter twice a day at equal weights of flour and water. A 75 percent hydration dough with a long cold proof gives an open crumb and a crackling crust.
title: A beginner's sourdough schedule

text:
Dialing in espresso

Grind finer if the shot runs fast and sour, coarser if it is slow and bitter. Aim for an 1:2 ratio in roughly 28 seconds.
title: Dialing in espresso

text:
Line length and readable type

Comfortable reading needs 45 to 90 characters per line. Generous leading and a serif body face help long-form text on screens.
title: Line length and readable type

text:
Why spaced repetition works

Reviewing material at growing intervals exploits the spacing effect. Each successful recall pushes the next review further out, which beats rereading for long-term memory.
title: Why spaced repetition works

text:
Training for a first marathon

Build weekly mileage slowly, keep most runs easy, and do one long run each weekend. Taper for two weeks before race day.
title: Training for a first marathon

text:
Notes on Marcus Aurelius

The Meditations return again and again to what is in our control. Marcus wrote them as private notes, never meant for publication.
title: Notes on Marcus Aurelius

text:
Postmortem: the DNS outage

A misconfigured CoreDNS autoscaler starved the cluster of resolvers during a traffic spike. Pods could not reach the database and the checkout service failed for 42 minutes.
title: Postmortem: the DNS outage

text:
Understanding ownership in Rust

Every value has a single owner; borrowing lets code read or mutate without taking ownership. The borrow checker rejects data races at compile time.
title: Understanding ownership in Rust

text:
Loose watercolor landscapes

Wet-on-wet washes for the sky, then dry brush for texture on rocks. Let the paper's white stand in for highlights instead of using white paint.
title: Loose watercolor landscapes

text:
Pruning a juniper bonsai

Pinch new growth in spring rather than cutting with scissors, which browns the foliage. Wire branches in autumn when the sap slows.
title: Pruning a juniper bonsai

text:
The case for index funds

Low-cost index funds beat most active managers after fees over long periods. Automatic monthly contributions remove the temptation to time the market.
title: The case for index funds

text:
How sleep consolidates memory

During slow-wave sleep the hippocampus replays the day's experiences, moving them into long-term cortical storage. Cutting sleep short impairs learning the next day.
title: How sleep consolidates memory

text:
Footwork drills for bouldering

Silent feet: place each foot without a sound to train precision. Most beginners overgrip with their hands because they do not trust their feet.
title: Footwork drills for bouldering

text:
Street trees cool cities

Neighbourhoods with dense tree canopy can be several degrees cooler in summer heat waves. Shade on asphalt cuts surface temperatures dramatically.
title: Street trees cool cities

text:
Evaluating LLM applications

Build a fixed set of real inputs with expected outputs and run it on every change. Judge changes by numbers, not by vibes from a few examples.
title: Evaluating LLM applications

text:
Retrieval augmented generation pitfalls

Chunking by fixed token windows splits tables and headings. Structure-aware chunks and a reranker over the top results usually beat a bigger embedding model.
title: Retrieval augmented generation pitfalls

text:
Lacto-fermented hot sauce

Mash chillies with 3 percent salt by weight and leave them under brine for two weeks. Blend with vinegar to stop fermentation before bottling.
title: Lacto-fermented hot sauce

text:
Designing a Japanese dry garden

Raked gravel stands for water and stones for mountains. Asymmetry and empty space matter as much as the objects placed.
title: Designing a Japanese dry garden

text:
Choosing switches for a mechanical keyboard

Linear switches feel smooth, tactile ones have a bump, clicky ones add sound. Lubing stabilizers removes most of the rattle on long keys.
title: Choosing switches for a mechanical keyboard

text:
Interactive rebase without fear

Use rebase to squash fixup commits before review. If something goes wrong, the reflog keeps every previous state of the branch.
title: Interactive rebase without fear

text:
Centering clay on the wheel

Brace your elbows against your thighs and let the wheel do the work. Wet hands and steady pressure bring the clay to the centre.
title: Centering clay on the wheel

text:
Cold water immersion and recovery

Short cold plunges reduce perceived soreness, but immediately after strength training they may blunt muscle growth.
title: Cold water immersion and recovery

text:
Complementary colors in UI

Pair a warm accent with cool neutrals. Orange on deep navy draws the eye without clashing, as long as contrast meets WCAG AA.
title: Complementary colors in UI

text:
Tuning autovacuum in Postgres

Lower the scale factor on large tables so vacuum runs before bloat builds up. Watch dead tuples in pg_stat_user_tables.
title: Tuning autovacuum in Postgres

text:
Identifying warblers by song

In dense spring foliage you will hear warblers long before you see them. Learn three common songs first, then add one each week.
title: Identifying warblers by song

text:
Owning fewer things

Keep only what you use or love. Fewer possessions mean less cleaning, fewer decisions, and more room for what matters.
title: Owning fewer things

text:
"Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability."
- Edsger Dijkstra
Gift ideas for Mum: a ceramic teapot, the new Ishiguro novel, or a weekend pottery class.
Shed project: buy cedar boards, a dozuki saw and a set of chisels. Try a simple half-lap joint first.

The physics of New York pizza

High-gluten flour and a 550 degree deck oven give the thin, foldable crust. Tap water gets credit it may not deserve.
title: The physics of New York pizza

text:
Rooftop solar payback

In sunny regions a rooftop system pays for itself in about seven years. Net metering rules decide most of the economics.
title: Rooftop solar payback

text:
Moving fast in Vim

Learn text objects: ciw changes a word, dap deletes a paragraph. Composable verbs and nouns make editing feel like speaking.
title: Moving fast in Vim
